select tmp.key_ "modelKey", max(tmp.name_) "name",
avg(nvl(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "average", max(nvl(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "maximum", min(nvl(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "minimum"
avg(IFNULL(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "average", max(IFNULL(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "maximum", min(IFNULL(tmp.time_diff, 0)) "minimum"
from ( select re.name_, re.key_, re.version_,
EXTRACT (MINUTE FROM hi.end_time_ - hi.start_time_) time_diff

from (select max(name_) name_, key_, max(version_) as version_ from ACT_RE_PROCDEF group by key_) re left join act_hi_procinst hi on re.key_ = hi.proc_def_key_ and hi.end_time_ is not null

where re.key_ in
#{entity.modelKey}
